name: enterprise-ai-platform
description: Token-efficient, deterministic AI commands for enterprise Java/Spring Boot/Angular/Flutter repositories. Provides /bug-fix, /migration, /new-development, /data-correction, /ui-design-update, /test, /prompt-audit, /dev. Single reasoning agent by default, lazy standards loading, MCP read-only allowlist, fail-closed security, no automatic agent chains (subagents are opt-in and capped at 3).
_removed_commands_note: v3.0 had /planning and /ui-redesign — removed in v3.1 (D2 fix)
